<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="vekVwc0MAqyCUMiy-cbQ" name="Página-4"> <mxGraphModel dx="2044" dy="1320" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam style strictuml
skinparam backgroundColor transparent

' Estilos visuales del diagrama
skinparam rectangle {
 BackgroundColor #00A4E4
 BorderColor #007acc
 FontColor white
 FontStyle bold
 FontSize 12
}

skinparam usecase {
 BackgroundColor #60A917
 BorderColor #2D7600
 FontColor white
 FontSize 11
}

skinparam hexagon {
 BackgroundColor #E3008C
 BorderColor #A20056
 FontColor white
 FontStyle bold
 FontSize 11
}

' ================= ENTIDADES (Rectángulos) =================
rectangle \"CATEGORIA\" as cat
rectangle \"PRODUCTO\" as prod
rectangle \"DESCUENTO_VOLUMEN\" as desc
rectangle \"PROVEEDOR\" as prov
rectangle \"COMPRA\" as compra
rectangle \"DETALLE_COMPRA\" as detc
rectangle \"ITEM_SERIADO\" as item
rectangle \"VENTA\" as venta
rectangle \"DETALLE_VENTA\" as detv

' ================= RELACIONES (Rombos/Hexágonos) =================
hexagon \"clasifica\" as rel_clasifica
hexagon \"aplica\" as rel_aplica
hexagon \"suministra\" as rel_suministra
hexagon \"origina\" as rel_origina
hexagon \"genera\" as rel_genera

' ================= ATRIBUTOS (Elipses) =================
' CATEGORIA
usecase \"<u>id_categoria</u>\" as cat_1
usecase \"nombre\" as cat_2
usecase \"descripcion\" as cat_3

cat -- cat_1
cat -- cat_2
cat -- cat_3

' PRODUCTO
usecase \"<u>id_producto</u>\" as prod_1
usecase \"nombre\" as prod_2
usecase \"precio_base\" as prod_3
usecase \"marca\" as prod_4
usecase \"modelo\" as prod_5
usecase \"stock_disponible\" as prod_6

prod -- prod_1
prod -- prod_2
prod -- prod_3
prod -- prod_4
prod -- prod_5
prod -- prod_6

' DESCUENTO_VOLUMEN
usecase \"<u>id_descuento</u>\" as desc_1
usecase \"cantidad_minima\" as desc_2
usecase \"precio_especial\" as desc_3

desc -- desc_1
desc -- desc_2
desc -- desc_3

' PROVEEDOR
usecase \"<u>id_proveedor</u>\" as prov_1
usecase \"nit_ruc\" as prov_2
usecase \"razon_social\" as prov_3
usecase \"telefono_email\" as prov_4

prov -- prov_1
prov -- prov_2
prov -- prov_3
prov -- prov_4

' COMPRA
usecase \"<u>id_compra</u>\" as comp_1
usecase \"monto_total\" as comp_2
usecase \"fecha_compra\" as comp_3

compra -- comp_1
compra -- comp_2
compra -- comp_3

' DETALLE_COMPRA
usecase \"<u>id_detalle_compra</u>\" as detc_1
usecase \"cantidad_costo_unitario\" as detc_2

detc -- detc_1
detc -- detc_2

' ITEM_SERIADO
usecase \"<u>id_item</u>\" as item_1
usecase \"imei_serial\" as item_2
usecase \"estado\" as item_3

item -- item_1
item -- item_2
item -- item_3

' VENTA
usecase \"<u>id_venta</u>\" as vent_1
usecase \"fecha_venta\" as vent_2
usecase \"monto_total_metodo_pago\" as vent_3

venta -- vent_1
venta -- vent_2
venta -- vent_3

' DETALLE_VENTA
usecase \"<u>id_detalle_venta</u>\" as detv_1
usecase \"cantidad_precio_unitario\" as detv_2
usecase \"subtotal\" as detv_3

detv -- detv_1
detv -- detv_2
detv -- detv_3

' ================= CONEXIONES ENTIDADES - RELACIONES =================
cat -- rel_clasifica
rel_clasifica -- prod

prod -- rel_aplica
rel_aplica -- desc

prov -- rel_suministra
rel_suministra -- compra

compra -- detc
detc -- rel_origina
rel_origina -- item

prod -- detc
venta -- rel_genera
rel_genera -- detv

prod -- detv
item .. detv

@enduml
